chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who enables (other men) unto himself willingly to play with him, Allah would Cast the desires of the women upon him'.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of allowing others to play with you willingly according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this hadith from Al-Kafi is often interpreted as a warning against *tawadu'* (modesty) that degenerates into *tadhallul* (self-debasement), where excessive humility invites disrespect. The phrase 'play with' (*yul'abu bihi*) suggests a loss of dignified presence, leading to a specific social consequence where one becomes an object of casual desire rather than respect. This reflects the broader ethical principle that maintaining one's spiritual and social stature (*haybah*) is essential to attracting appropriate reverence.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Talha Bin Zayd, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one whom enables (other men) unto himself willingly to play with him, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Cast the desires of the women upon him’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah bin Zayd who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
One who allows sexual intercourse in his anus voluntarily and playfully Allah throws lust of woman on him. 5 ”
